events.description: Multiple failed SSH login attempts for root from the same IP address (192.168.1.105), indicating a possible brute force attack.
events.recommendation: Implement rate limiting on SSH access and consider using fail2ban or similar tools to block repeated failed attempts.

events.description: Successful SSH login for root from an external IP address (185.220.101.45) following multiple failed attempts from an internal IP.
events.recommendation: Immediately investigate the circumstances surrounding the successful login. Revoke any unauthorized access and change the root password. Consider implementing two-factor authentication.

events.description: A user (kong) executed a command with root privileges, which could be suspicious if this user does not typically use elevated privileges.
events.recommendation: Review the command executed by user kong for legitimacy and monitor for any further unusual actions by this user.

events.description: USB device connected with unknown manufacturer, which might indicate an unauthorized device being attached to the system.
events.recommendation: Investigate the USB connection and ensure that it is secure and authorized. Review logs for any data transfer or unexpected behavior following this connection.

events.description: Multiple failed SSH login attempts for root from the same IP.
events.recommendation: Implement SSH rate limiting and change root access to be more secure. Consider using key-based authentication instead of password-based.

events.description: Successful SSH login for root from an external IP after multiple failed attempts.
events.recommendation: Immediately investigate the source of the successful login. Disable root login and enforce strong password policies. Monitor for suspicious activity.

events.description: User 'kong' executed a shell command as root.
events.recommendation: Audit the actions of user 'kong' and restrict sudo access if necessary. Ensure proper user account controls are in place.

events.description: USB device connected with unknown manufacturer.
events.recommendation: Investigate the connected USB device for potential threats. Limit USB access on server if it is not needed.
